description: Brad Frost's hierarchy for interfaces: atoms, molecules, organisms, templates and pages.
A product-agnostic library of tokens, components, patterns and guidelines shared across products (Polaris, Carbon, Primer).
Named design decisions (color, spacing, type, radius, motion), layered as primitive → semantic → component and shipped as CSS variables.
A token that encodes intent (`color-action-primary`) and points to a primitive value; components use these so themes only change values.
Components built from parts and `children` (`Card.Header`) instead of growing boolean props for every variation.
Libraries such as Radix, React Aria and Base UI that provide behavior and accessibility without styles, for a design system to skin.
